title: REACT: Representational Early Analysis and Control of Chain-of-Thought Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.32113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) generation offers an opportunity to intervene before a reasoning model completes its answer. But does the point at which risk is easiest to detect also offer the most effective control? We study this question with REACT, a conditional activation intervention that learns a safety direction from paired safe and unsafe trajectories and applies it once to an early CoT hidden state. The model weights remain frozen, and all subsequent tokens are generated without further edits. To study timing, we train directions separately at each of the first five CoT positions and evaluate ungated edits with full post-edit regeneration. Across three distilled reasoning models and three generation seeds, the strongest gains concentrate in a two- to three-token early window; on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, the effect falls to approximately zero at the fourth and fifth tokens, even though later states can be more predictive of risk.

translated_title: REACT：思维链轨迹的表征早期分析与控制
translated_abstract: 思维链生成提供了一种在推理模型完成回答之前进行干预的机会。但是，风险最容易被检测到的时间点是否也能提供最有效的控制？我们通过 REACT 来研究这个问题，这是一种条件性激活干预方法，它从成对的安全与不安全轨迹中学习一个安全方向，并将其一次性应用于早期的思维链隐藏状态。模型权重保持冻结，所有后续 token 的生成不再进行进一步编辑。为了研究时机问题，我们在前五个思维链位置上分别训练方向，并使用无门控编辑配合编辑后的完整重新生成进行评估。在三个蒸馏推理模型和三个生成种子上，最强的增益集中在两到三个 token 的早期窗口内；在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上，效果在第四和第五个 token 处降至接近于零，尽管较晚的状态可能更能预测风险。
tldr: REACT 提出一种从成对安全与不安全轨迹中学习安全方向、并一次性施加于思维链早期隐藏状态的激活干预方法，发现最强控制增益集中在思维链的前两到三个 token 窗口，即使后续状态更能预测风险。
en_tdlr: REACT applies a one-time activation intervention along a safety direction learned from paired safe/unsafe trajectories to early chain-of-thought hidden states, showing that control gains concentrate in the first two-to-three token window even when later states are more predictive of risk.
